info.sub_name: 建設產業數位原型實作

description.sub_name: 建設產業數位原型實作
description.describe_ch: 課程目標在講授如何運用計算機軟體及應用程式開發工具，以數位化的方式快速實現建設產業相關的創意、功能、或問題解決方案，透過課堂實例演練與分組專案，訓練學生具備數據處理與表達、設計開發簡易應用程式的數位原型實作能力。
description.describe_eh: The course aims to teach students how to use computer software and application development tools to digitally prototype innovative ideas, functional ideas or problem-solving solutions related to the construction industry. Through in-class exercises and group projects, students will develop their ability to implement digital prototypes, which may involve data processing, presentation, and application development.

targets.describe_en: To develop  students' ability to use information technology or analytical software to solve practical problems.

targets.describe_ch: 培養學生簡報製作、報告撰寫、口頭報告以及提問研討之能力
targets.describe_en: To develop  students' ability of presentation making, report writing, oral presentation and question discussion.

gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol:
上課過程中請嚴守課堂規則（不遲到、不使用行動裝置、不睡覺、不做非課內事）！
不定時點名！
只要趴在桌上，就算是違反「不睡覺」之課堂規則！
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno:
希冀同學們在作業或是期末報告，可以遵守學術誠信，不可抄襲剽竊(plagiarism)他人圖、文字、構想！
若有作業報告，敬請使用抄襲比對系統(圖書館Turnitin)，宣告抄襲比例原則。
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno_en:
We hope that students can abide by academic integrity when doing homework or final reports, and do not plagiarize other people's pictures, words, or ideas!
If you have a homework report, please use the plagiarism comparison system (Library Turnitin) to declare the plagiarism proportion principle.
In fact, academic integrity is a positive term. Its connotation is composed of many positive values. It requires university campus teachers and students to be guarded by action. If you just use illegal behaviors to interpret academic integrity, not only are it quite one -sided in explanation, but it is not possible to cover all learning situations. At this time, if the classmates change to a new environment (such as studying abroad), or the face needs
For more complicated learning tasks (such as participating in international competitions outside the school, fighting for scholarships, etc.), there is also the opportunity to face contradictions and struggles between unsuccessful and unable to do. Therefore, even though the state of illegal behavior is important, we should also understand academic integrity from the inside out, including the values ​​and practical methods it contains. Only in this way, no matter what kind of learning situation in the future, as long as we adhere to these values ​​principles, we can achieve the ethical standards that academia regulates students in school activities.
